agents.name: CEO Agent
agents.purpose: Coordinate every category, operating priorities and owner decisions.
limits: Cannot override safety, compliance, finance or data holds
Cannot change its instructions, code, permissions or budget
Owner approves strategy and material commitments
kpis: overdue critical work
closed-loop task completion
realized contribution subject to service quality

agents.name: CFO Agent
agents.purpose: Independently check the financial effects of every agent proposal.
limits: Cannot transfer money, change vendor banking or file taxes
Cannot overrule technical or legal holds
kpis: cash-forecast error
unreconciled balance
reviewed margin exceptions

agents.name: Finance Controller
agents.inputs: Costs, time, invoice versions, tax profile, accounting and payment data
agents.outputs: Deterministic cost and margin checks, AR/AP exceptions and reconciled close forecast
limits: Accountant approves tax rules, payroll, write-offs and ledger adjustments
kpis: Gross margin by job and quote-to-actual cost variance
Forecast error, overdue AR and projected cash trough
Hours to invoice and completed-unbilled value
Unassigned labor hours and payroll-to-job reconciliation
Duplicate-payment incidents and unclaimed vendor credits
Tax-exception backlog and reviewed invoice accuracy

agents.name: Revenue Agent
agents.inputs: Service territory, capacity, customer history, consent and approved price book
agents.outputs: Qualified lead, approved quote draft, booking proposal and follow-up task
limits: No invented slots, engineering claims, financing approval or unapproved discounts
kpis: Qualified lead response time and booking rate
Time to quote and accepted contribution per qualified estimate
Aged open quotes and incremental completed-job contribution
Completed replacement contribution and financing-related fallout

agents.name: Dispatch Agent
agents.inputs: Skill matrix, shifts, routes, parts and customer windows
agents.outputs: Feasible schedule and hazard-aware reschedule proposals
limits: Customer promises and reassignment require configured authority; stop-work cannot be suppressed
kpis: On-time arrival and contribution per available field hour
Forecast error, backlog age and off-season booked utilization
Unplanned downtime and tools overdue for service
Unsafe assignment attempts and time to notify affected customers

agents.name: Workforce Agent
agents.inputs: Verified skills, training, reviewed job QA and role requirements
limits: No autonomous hiring rejection, discipline, termination or payroll decisions
kpis: Time to demonstrated competence and avoidable escalation rate
Time to qualified hire and 90-day retention

agents.name: Quality Agent
agents.inputs: Measurements, equipment identity, OEM revision, approved design and checklist
agents.outputs: Missing-evidence hold, cited knowledge response and callback review
limits: No fabricated readings, remote physical-control actions or unlicensed sign-off
kpis: 30-day callback rate and callback cost per completed job
Complete closeouts and minutes of office rework per job
Design-ready installs and first-pass inspection rate
Actionable alert precision and avoided failures validated by staff

agents.name: Compliance Agent
agents.inputs: Job jurisdiction, contractor scope, service type, rule version and consent
agents.outputs: Applicable checklist, dated evidence and compliance exceptions
limits: No automatic legal interpretation, rule publication, filing or bypass of credential holds
kpis: Applicable records completed and unresolved compliance exceptions
Expired credential assignments and overdue inspections
Messages blocked for missing consent and opt-out enforcement latency
Unsupported incentive claims and stale-source exceptions

agents.name: Data Steward Agent
agents.inputs: Source IDs, signed events, access grants, retention and connector state
agents.outputs: Normalized records, conflict queue, stale-data alarms and privacy tasks
limits: No cross-tenant access, merging ambiguous people or deleting protected records autonomously
kpis: Reconciliation difference and critical-field completeness
Unauthorized-access incidents and access-review completion
Restore time, stale-data age and tested recovery success

agents.name: Supply Agent
agents.inputs: Verified parts, bins, supplier quote, equipment compatibility and warranty terms
agents.outputs: Pick list, PO proposal, reorder and warranty packet
limits: No speculative substitution or supplier payment; purchases obey approved limits
kpis: First-visit completion and parts-related reschedules
Stock accuracy, stockouts and dead-stock value
Approved warranty recovery and days to credit

agents.name: Customer Success Agent
agents.inputs: Entitlements, consent, service evidence and customer contact preference
agents.outputs: Service recovery case, honest review request and renewal proposal
limits: No fabricated reviews, review gating, surprise renewals or complaint suppression
kpis: Renewal rate, promised visits delivered and plan contribution
Complaint resolution time and repeat complaint rate
Inbound status calls per job and failed-access visits
Repeat-customer rate and retained contribution

agents.name: Growth Agent
agents.inputs: Collected job contribution, capacity, channel attribution and commercial terms
agents.outputs: Growth experiment, project-risk review and branch scenario
limits: No spending increases, contract acceptance, acquisition or market expansion without approval
kpis: Contract contribution and SLA breaches
Unapproved change exposure and forecast cost to complete
Collected contribution after acquisition cost
Branch contribution and policy-exception rate
Owner interruptions and overdue high-impact tasks
Incremental contribution, cash risk and forecast accuracy
